messages:
sam_cs: Quick ping  we need a short proactive note for four priority customers impacted by this morning's embed ingest slowdown. Draft below for lightning review. @tara_success @mike_ops

tara_success: We should be explicit about what customers will see on their upcoming invoice. Use 'pro-rated invoice adjustment' instead of 'credit' for clarity with finance.

mike_ops: Timeline: spike observed ~11:58 UTC, fallback routing to warm dedicated node group at 12:20 UTC. Ingest backlog cleared by 12:46 UTC; we're still finishing targeted retries. Expected final catch-up by EOD.

mike_ops: Ops debug command if customers ask for technical detail:
```
# toggle fallback routing for tenant
POST /internal/tenants/<TENANT>/routing
{ "mode": "fallback-dedicated" }
```

elaine_product: Recommend offering a 30-min office-hours slot (not one-off enablement) so we can review their ingest config and future-proof throughput. We'll capture notes for product improvements.

ben_onboard: I can take scheduling. Suggest two blocks: Thu 08:30-10:00 PT and Fri 14:00-16:00 PT. I'll follow up 1:1 after the note goes.

sam_cs: Draft email (send from cs@redwood):
"Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a brief disruption to embeddings ingestion that began at ~11:58 UTC today. To protect throughput we temporarily routed affected workloads to reserved warm capacity; this removed the backlog but you may experience slightly higher latency on some requests until catch-up completes.

What we're doing now:
- Activated regional fallback to reserved capacity (completed).
- Running targeted retries and backfill to clear queued items (in progress).
- Conducting a root cause analysis and will share findings within 48 hours.

Billing note: we will apply a pro-rated invoice adjustment to cover measurable impact during the affected window. Your CS contact will confirm the exact amount and how it appears on your bill.

Offer: Were hosting dedicated office-hours to review ingest patterns and tuning; book a 30-minute slot here: <office-hours-link>.

If this is impacting a live workflow, reply to this email or open a priority support ticket and we will escalate.

Thank you for your patience,
Redwood Customer Success"

tara_success: Minor edit: change "priority support ticket" -> "priority support request". Also add FAQ: "Will my data move regions? No  routing stayed within your configured region."

mike_ops: Confirmed no cross-region movement; KV cache integrity verified. No data loss risk.

srebot: Incident 1799989000  Embedded ingest throughput degraded; mitigation: regional fallback in effect. Status: monitoring.

sam_cs: Approved by Tara. I'll send to the four priority contacts now and CC Tara. ben_onboard will handle scheduling.

elaine_product: I'll draft a two-question feedback card to attach after each office-hours session to capture pain points and tuning wins.

sam_cs: Sending now. Will post updates here as responses come in."
